question: Estimate the conversion rate from a TV shopping channel (HomeShop18 / NaaptolMax) ad-impressionn to purchase.
idealClarificationQuestions: TV shopping channel ad exposure → call placed → product purchased? Yes.
TV viewers who saw the product offer? Yes.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average TV shopping channel reach (specific product slot)
Engaged viewers (watched >30 sec of the product pitch)
Of callers, completed transaction (incl. follow-up calls)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~70% (high RTO in TV shopping) = ~500-560 net successful purchases.

calculationFlow: Average TV shopping channel reach (specific product slot): ~10 lakh viewers.
Engaged viewers (watched >30 sec of the product pitch): ~20% = 2 lakh.
Of these, called helpline number: ~1% = 2,000 callers.
Of callers, completed transaction (incl. follow-up calls): ~30-40% = 700-800 orders.
Of placed orders, COD non-refusal (successful delivery + payment): ~70% (high RTO in TV shopping) = ~500-560 net successful purchases.
